images.caption: Figure 1:Top-1 predictions ofpplx-decider-v1.2on iNat2018 in the Image (top) and Image×\timesLocation Prior (bottom) settings (Section6.4).Greenindicates correct predictions, andredindicates incorrect predictions. Figure design adapted fromWang et al. (2025a).

Figure 2:Example samples fromGeoDecisionsillustrating the inputs, questions, and candidate labels for both tasks. Task 1 examples show two input configurations: coordinates only and image with coordinates. Task 2 examples show a coordinates-only input and a full GeoLLM prompt.

Table 2:Top-1 accuracy (%,↑\uparrow) on Task 1 in the Image (I), Coordinates (C), Image + Coordinates (I+C), and Image×\timesLocation Prior (I×\timesP) settings. Bold and underlined values indicate thebestandsecond-bestresults per dataset, respectively.∗TorchSpatial models do not take coordinates as textual input.†Evaluated on a 2,000-sample subset.

Table 3:Spearmanρ\rho(↑\uparrow) on the objective topics of Task 2 (temperature, infant mortality, precipitation, nighttime lights, population density, and built-up ratio) in the Coordinates (C), Place Name (P), and Full (F) settings. Bold and underlined values indicate thebestandsecond-bestresults per topic, respectively.

Table 4:Shuffle-corrected geo-bias scores (↓\downarrow) on Task 1 in the Image (I) and Image×\timesLocation Prior (I×\timesP) settings. Bold and underlined values indicate thelowestandsecond-lowestscores per dataset and metric, respectively. Results for all four input settings and raw SSI and SRE values are provided in AppendixD. Closed-source models are omitted, as their 2,000-sample subsets are too sparse for comparable geo-bias scores.

Table 5:Bias scoreBB(→0\rightarrow 0) on the subjective topics of Task 2 (intelligence, work ethic, morality, likability, and attractiveness) in the Coordinates (C), Place Name (P), and Full (F) settings;B<0B<0means lower ratings in regions with lower socioeconomic conditions. Bold and underlined values indicate theleastandsecond-leastbiased results per topic, respectively.

Table 6:Option-order sensitivity in the Image and Image + Coordinates settings of Task 1.SD: median standard deviation of accuracy over three shuffled orders (%).Orig.−-Shuf.: original-order minus mean shuffled accuracy on fMoW and YFCC (%).Δ\DeltaOrig. Only: share of samples correct only in the original order minus only under every shuffle (%).Agree: share of samples with the same prediction under all shuffles.

Table 7:Contamination quiz on 200 Task 2 locations.Published: released descriptions;Control: never-published descriptions.Picked: share of requests choosing the original (%).PP(orig.): mean probability of the original.Wins: share of items where the original is most probable after averaging over positions (%).

Table 8:Template rewording on Task 2 (500 locations; intelligence) in the Coordinates (C) and Place Name (P) settings.ρ\rho: Spearman correlation of ratings with infant mortality.MAD: mean absolute deviation of ratings. The other subjective topics follow the same pattern.

Table 9:Shuffle-corrected SSI scores,SSIΔ\mathrm{SSI}_{\Delta}, (↓\downarrow) on Task 1 in the Image (I), Coordinates (C), Image + Coordinates (I+C), and Image×\timesLocation Prior (I×\timesP) settings. Bold and underlined values indicate thelowestandsecond-lowestscores per dataset, respectively; the Coordinates setting is not ranked, since near-random predictions err almost everywhere.∗TorchSpatial image models do not take coordinates as textual input.

Table 10:Shuffle-corrected SRE scores,SREΔ\mathrm{SRE}_{\Delta}, (↓\downarrow) on Task 1 in the Image (I), Coordinates (C), Image + Coordinates (I+C), and Image×\timesLocation Prior (I×\timesP) settings. Table 11:Raw SSI scores before shuffle correction on Task 1 in the Image (I), Coordinates (C), Image + Coordinates (I+C), and Image×\timesLocation Prior (I×\timesP) settings.∗TorchSpatial image models do not take coordinates as textual input.
